name: express-axios-app
description: TypeScript Express server serving a Vue client, using npm workspaces

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.docker:stop-remove: docker stop express-vue-app-container && docker rm express-vue-app-container
